title: ALTER TABLE ... IMPORT TABLESPACE may cause unsafe reads

comments.text:

regards,

Hello Huahua Xu! 
Thank you for offering a patch.
Can you please sign the OCA (see Contributions tab, https://bugs.mysql.com/bug.php?id=115951&contribs=1 ) so we can use it?
Posted by developer: Bug status updated to 'Patch pending'
Posted by developer: Bug status updated to 'Patch approved'

Hello - turned out the patch had to be substantially larger (to include permanent changes to DD, partitioned tables, and MTR tests) and different than the contribution.

Also AFAICT the OCA was not yet signed.

For these two reasons this commit will not be explicitly marked as a contribution.

Still, I'd like to thank you for bringing this issue to our attention, and proposing a sketch!
Posted by developer: Bug status updated to 'Documenting'

Posted by developer:
 
Added the following note to the MySQL Server 8.4.13, 9.7.4, and 26.10.0 release notes:

        Fixed an issue relating to InnoDB reads using older transaction
        views after tablespace import.
